## YSA Conference Committee Member, Volunteer Coordinator
**The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints** · `Aug 2026`

When a young single adult conference needed someone to keep the gaming lounge running and attendees moving smoothly between activities, I stepped in as both tech support and traffic control. Consoles glitch, tournaments run behind schedule, and first-time attendees need a friendly face at the door — I handled all three. Beyond troubleshooting equipment, I organized the logistics for racing tournaments and group gaming activities, and served as one of the first points of contact at check-in, making sure people knew where to go and what was happening next.

- Provided IT troubleshooting and technical support for gaming consoles and equipment, minimizing downtime during high-traffic events
- Coordinated group logistics and participant flow for gaming activities and racing tournaments
- Welcomed attendees at check-in and guided them through event schedules and venue navigation

## Peer Mentor
**Brigham Young University–Idaho** · `Apr 2025 – Aug 2025`

Six freshmen, one semester, and a lot riding on whether they'd find their footing. I took on the role of mentor not just as an academic advisor but as a consistent presence — someone checking in twice a week, every week, to make sure goals weren't just being set but actually followed through on. We built individualized plans together, talked through course selection and study strategies, and worked through the ordinary struggles of a first semester away from home. By the end of the term, the group showed measurable GPA improvement, and several of those mentoring relationships didn't end when the semester did — I'm still in touch with some of them.

- Mentored 6 freshman students, providing structured academic and personal guidance over one semester
- Developed individualized goal-setting plans and led biweekly progress meetings to track accountability
- Advised on course selection, study strategies, and campus resources
- Organized social integration activities to support student retention
- Maintained ongoing mentor relationships beyond the official mentoring period

## Dance Instructor
**Brigham Young University–Idaho** · `Jan 2024 – Dec 2024`

For a full year, I taught weekly Latin dance lessons to groups of 15 or more — some walking in with zero rhythm and a lot of nerves, others returning to sharpen technique. Dance became a low-stakes way to build real confidence and connection across a diverse group of students. I worked alongside a team of 8–10 fellow instructors to design lesson plans and coordinate larger cultural events, always with an eye toward the *why* behind the *how*: Latin dance carries real cultural and historical weight, and part of my job was making sure that context didn't get lost in the choreography.

- Delivered weekly group instruction to 15+ participants, building confidence and teamwork through dance
- Led monthly individualized lessons tailored to skill level and performance goals
- Collaborated with 8–10 instructors to design lesson plans and coordinate cultural events
- Promoted the social and historical significance of Latin dance traditions

## I-Serve | Project Manager
**Brigham Young University–Idaho** · `Jan 2023 – Apr 2023`

This was community service at the coordination level and the shovel level, both. As project manager, I worked alongside a team of other managers to plan and organize service projects for students across the community — one of the standout efforts being a cleanup at the Romance Theatre, restoring a shared public space that mattered to the people around it. My role wasn't limited to logistics from the sidelines, either: I showed up as part of the hands-on support crew for several projects, working the actual cleanup alongside the students I'd helped recruit and organize. It gave me a full picture of what it takes to run community service well — the planning meetings *and* the work gloves.

- Coordinated with fellow project managers to plan and organize community service projects for students
- Organized a student cleanup effort at the Romance Theatre, restoring a shared civic space
- Participated directly as part of the hands-on support team on multiple service projects

## Marketing Director — Economic Society
**Brigham Young University–Idaho** · `Jan 2023 – Aug 2023`
`
Getting students to actually show up to an event is a different problem than getting them to say they will — and closing that gap was the core of this role. Over eight months, I planned and executed 10 campaigns tied to workshops, speaker panels, and society events, writing and distributing 15+ promotional emails alongside a steady stream of social posts and event promos. The real win wasn't the volume of outreach, it was what it did to conversion: I took the registration-to-attendance rate from 25% up to 75%, tracking metrics along the way to figure out what actually moved people from "interested" to "in the room."

- Planned and executed 10 marketing campaigns around events, workshops, and speaker panels
- Wrote and distributed 15+ promotional emails and expanded social media outreach
- Tracked attendance, reach, and conversion metrics, improving registration-to-attendance from 25% to 75%

## Class Representative
**English Language Center** · `Jan 2022 – May 2022`

As class representative, I served as the bridge between students and faculty — the person peers came to when something needed advocating for, and the one relaying it to the people who could act on it. The highlight of the term was helping plan and execute the Center's 40th-anniversary celebration, coordinating everything from class activities to stage presentations alongside a team of fellow representatives. I also helped spearhead a food and meal donation drive, mobilizing classmates to give back to the surrounding community, and spent regular time one-on-one with classmates working through language-learning strategies and course questions.

- Served as primary liaison between peers and faculty, advocating for student needs
- Co-planned the Center's 40th-anniversary celebration, including activities and stage presentations
- Spearheaded a food and meal donation drive for community support
- Provided personalized guidance on learning methodologies and language acquisition strategies

## Dinner Line
**Missionary Training Center** · `Dec 2021`

Feeding over 100 missionaries a shift is less about cooking and more about choreography — timing, inventory, and a team that knows exactly where to be. I worked as part of a 10-member team coordinating meal service across multiple dining areas, assisted the head chef weekly with prep and kitchen operations, and handled cash control and register balancing to keep transactions accurate. It was fast, physical, service-oriented work, and it taught me a lot about staying organized under real time pressure.

- Served 100+ missionaries per shift across multiple dining areas
- Assisted the head chef weekly with meal preparation and kitchen operations
- Managed food inventory handling and storage in compliance with safety standards
- Maintained cleanliness and sanitation across dining areas
- Coordinated with a 10-member team on meal service and special events
- Handled cash control and register balancing

## Student Buddy — Spanish
**Brigham Young University** · `Jan 2020 – Dec 2020`

For a full year, I led weekly Spanish–English language exchange sessions, working one-on-one and in small groups to build conversational fluency and confidence on both sides of the exchange. I designed a monthly personalized practice program — twelve programs over twelve months — to reinforce vocabulary and speaking skills between sessions, and structured lessons around grammar, listening, speaking, and writing so the learning stayed balanced rather than lopsided toward just conversation.

- Facilitated weekly language exchange sessions for 12 months, strengthening bilingual communication
- Designed a monthly personalized practice program (12 total) to reinforce vocabulary and speaking confidence
- Delivered structured lessons covering grammar, listening, speaking, and writing
